data.title: Siniyah Island
data.about:
Siniyah Island in Umm Al Quwain is an upcoming development by Sobha Realty. The project's first phase spans a total area of 16.1 million sq. ft. This exclusive project features a mix of villas and residential apartments, complemented by two branded ultra-luxury resorts. With a stunning 6 km beach, every villa boasts direct waterfront access, ensuring unparalleled coastal living. Other amenities include golf course, lagoons, beach, and parks.

The Sobha new launch is thoughtfully designed, with 27% of the area dedicated to green spaces and water bodies, enhancing the serene environment. Siniyah Island also holds significant heritage value, with notable historical findings adding to its allure. The initial development phase includes 196 villas, offering a blend of modern luxury and rich cultural heritage.

characteristics_module.title: From Stunning Villas to World-Class Amenities in the Heart of Umm Al Quwain
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Excellent accommodation options in Siniyah Island Phase 1 ranging from 4 to 6-bedroom villas..
  • A family-friendly golf course designed to provide residents with a perfect blend of leisure and sport amidst stunning natural surroundings.
  • Two branded ultra-luxury resorts offer world-class accommodations, exceptional dining, and rejuvenating spa experiences, ensuring a lavish lifestyle for residents and visitors.
  • A state-of-the-art clubhouse featuring recreational facilities, event halls, and social spaces fosters a vibrant community atmosphere and provides a hub for relaxation and entertainment.
  • An opportunity to live in the tranquil Umm Al Quwain, a hub of natural and historical attractions.

location_tile.title: Siniyah Island Phase 1: Where Heritage Meets Luxury on the Waterfront
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Umm Al Quwain, one of the seven emirates of the UAE, is renowned for its rich history, serene beaches, and vibrant culture. Situated along the Arabian Gulf, this tranquil emirate offers a stark contrast to the bustling cities of Dubai and Abu Dhabi. 

Umm Al Quwain is also developing as a modern tourist destination. The emirate boasts a range of recreational activities, from water sports and sailing at the UAQ Marine Club to thrilling experiences at the Dreamland Aqua Park, one of the largest water parks in the region.

20 minutes to Marjan Island
40 minutes to Ajman Corniche
50 minutes to Dubai International Airport
60 minutes to Business Bay

more_info.answer: Siniyah Island offers a range of premium properties, including 4 to 6-bedroom villas, mansions, marina apartments, and beachfront apartments, all designed to provide luxury and comfort.
more_info.question: What types of premium properties are available on Siniyah Island?

more_info.answer: Yes, there are various properties for sale on Siniyah Island, including villas, mansions, and apartments. These properties offer direct waterfront access and are part of a prestigious residential project by Sobha Realty.
more_info.question: Are there properties for sale on Siniyah Island in Umm Al Quwain?

more_info.answer: The Siniyah Island residential project features a family-friendly golf course, two branded ultra-luxury resorts, a state-of-the-art clubhouse, and ample green spaces. These amenities ensure a luxurious and active lifestyle for residents.
more_info.question: What amenities are included in the Siniyah Island residential project?

more_info.answer: The Siniyah Island Umm Al Quwain community is unique due to its blend of modern luxury and natural beauty. It offers serene living with direct waterfront access, lush green spaces, and proximity to the rich heritage and natural attractions of Umm Al Quwain.
